data.name: Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge – Master the Art of Combat!

Enter the world of Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge, a fast-paced hack 'n' slash action game where skill and strategy define the battlefield. With a diverse roster of characters, each wielding unique movesets and combat styles, you’ll experience fluid, high-energy battles like never before.

Master the multi-stance combat system, seamlessly switching between stances and attack modes to chain devastating combos.

Prepare for intense battles, fast-paced action, and limitless possibilities in Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge! Will you rise to the challenge?

🔥 Demo (ALPHA PLAYTEST IN PROGRESS):

The demo represents an early playtest build of *Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge*. Systems, combat, and visuals are still actively being refined.

You may encounter bugs, incomplete features, or rough edges during gameplay. Your feedback is incredibly valuable in helping shape the final experience.

Thank you for playing and being part of the development process.

Press kit: check game website

Boss Fight Mode – Face off against the Wolf King using Nyx; an offensive counterstance combo heavy unit and Elaine, a defensive parry based unit with a short burst flurry mode.

Character trials – Experience Evelynn, a ninjutsu based spellcaster, Esme, a gunslinging aerial juggle master, and Rinne the scythe wielding goddess of fire who can cast combustible curse marks and other vicious and destructive tricks. 

Quarters – The home base of the OPERATOR. Relax with Esme in the space hotel, listen to some music, and chat / write notes on the Operator’s phone to give feedback! The Quarters will be the main hub where you’ll be able to tackle different missions and expand rooms to house and interact with your Conduits.

Options menu while limited allows you to rebind keys although control scheme for the Operator cannot be changed.

What will be in the FULL game? Additional character releases, more enemies, story chapters, new game modes to tackle, 3-character swapping combat with freedom of party choice, and an inventory system with stat based gear and cosmetics that can modify the user’s combat capabilities depending on their preferences! 

🛡️ Key Features:

✅ Build Your Dream Team – Collect and customize a roster of powerful warriors.
✅ 3-Unit Mid-Battle Swapping – Planned Feature. Currently in development. Some form of 2-unit swapping is available in demo, but not a complete feature yet.

✅ Multi-Stance System – Certain characters can shift between fighting styles on the fly.

✅Summon mechanics – Certain characters may be able to summon hover bikes, dragons, wolves, or other mountable items to use in battle.

✅Epic Loot & Power-Ups – Defeat enemies and bosses to earn gear & game-changing power-items.

⚠️ Upcoming Features:

Assemble your ultimate team, swap between characters mid-battle, and unleash powerful abilities to dominate your foes!

📖 The Story

The world has fallen to the Behemoths—, otherworldly entities of unknown origin. Forced to abandon Earth, humanity now survives in exile, divided among the East, West, and Central Branch.

To fight back, technology was developed to extract entities from the Astral Plane, forging them into powerful android warriors known as Conduits. Paired with Operators—gifted humans capable of syncing with them through a process called tethering—these warriors were humanity’s last hope. But the war was lost. The Operators fell. And the reclamation of Earth became a distant dream.

Until now.

You are the last Operator with a miraculous ability—one that defies all known limits. You can tether with multiple Conduits, unlocking hidden potential unseen in centuries.

Venture into the Astral Plane, uncover the truth behind the Behemoth invasion, and forge bonds strong enough to shatter fate itself.

The battle for Earth is not over. It has only just begun.

🌎 The World of Remnant Blade

Eastern Branch
A highly advanced artificial metropolis deep inside the Moon, hidden from Earth’s turmoil. Despite its utopian facade, a dark secret threatens its very existence.

Western Branch
An underground city on the Earth, struggling to survive amid scarce resources and constant danger from Earth’s monstrous Behemoths. Crime and decay dominate this dystopian refuge.

Central Branch
The last hope for humanity, a massive ring world serving as a command center for the war to reclaim Earth. Every battle brings them closer to saving their home from extinction.

The Astral Plane
A realm of pure thought and energy, where logic breaks down and reality bends. It can take on countless forms, shifting through cultural eras, time periods, and the imagination of those who enter. Powerful beings shape its expanse, but an unknown darkness threatens to corrupt it and invade humanity’s dreams.

Within the expanse of the Astral Plane are isolated and self contained realms. Numbered eras are designated realms where Behemoths have been discovered.

🎭Playable Characters

Evelynn the “ninja girl”

The Operator’s first Conduit and a Kunoichi from the 3rd era Eastern Branch. She is an outcast due to her being of western descent. Unable to come to terms with her world, she does not hesitate when joining the Operator; Reaching 100% sync with upon pairing. Her mysterious past somehow solidifies this connection. She vows to protect the Operator with her life.

Rinne the “Goddess of Fire”

A Deviant or corrupted being who was born from the flames of battle through a Conduit with immense willpower. She is an anomaly within the ranks of the Behemoths and acts of her own free will. With the leverage to restore something dear to him, she and the operator make a pact.

Kyo the swordsman

A rare male type Conduit from the Eastern Branch who is a renegade Drifter; wandering swordsman. Arrogant and cocky, but has the skill to show for it. He wields a cursed blade that can cut through time itself which he is very protective of.

Esme the spec ops cat

Drifter from the Eastern Branch who lost her Operator. She wanders the surface with high level resourcefulness and survivability, often relying on her gadgets to get by. She creates an exo suit that replicates full sync, allowing her to tether with anyone seamlessly.

Nyx the “Goddess of Darkness”

A Deviant originally from the Eastern Branch. Like Evelynn, she has a rare ability to stop time momentarily, caused by shadows she casts over the world. She holds a secret not even her Deviant comrades know about, and her fighting style resembles that of Evelynn’s.

Vex the blazing fury

A Deviant under the command of Rinne that make up the Crimson Brigade. She’s hot headed and fierce but has a soft spot for the Operator. Vex has a very close relationship with Lily and Rinne; something extremely unconventional with Deviants who usually lack any kind of elements of sympathy humanity. 

Elaine the Last Knight

Also goes by Ella; prefers never to be called by her old name. Last surviving member of the Western branch 2nd era. An incorruptible Knight who wishes to restore the fallen Western branch to its rightful glory. 

Lily the Succubus Queen

Member of the Crimson Brigade branch of the Deviants. She captures humans on the surface to become surrogate Deviant Operators. Unlike normal Deviants who are tethered to an unknown central entity, the Crimson Brigade is disconnected and require tethering to humans.

Jade the Dark Elf

An ancient Deviant from the 1st era Western Branch. Freed from corruption, she partners with Ella to restore the Western Branch.

Fallen Hero

A man of unknown origin who accompanies the Crimson Brigade as their servant. He is a hollow and empty body puppeteered by a demonic entity. 

Vivian the temptress

A blader from the 5th era Eastern Branch. A refugee from the fall of the Western Branch.

The Operator

The Operator specializes in basic modern firearms and can be controlled in 1st person during some parts of the game; most notably lower risk areas on the surface to find Drifting conduits dead or alive to tether with. The Operator has his own motives and personality as he takes the player for a ride on his journey through 1st person.

data.short_description: Unleash brutal combat in Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge, a fast-paced hack n slash with dynamic stances, unique characters, and deep combat mechanics. Master your moveset and dominate foes with precision and style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8300H or AMD Ryzen 5 3550H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H or AMD Ryzen 7 4800H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD RX 5700 XT (8 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge features stylized action combat against fantasy and demonic enemies. The game contains 'waifu' style character designs with revealing outfits, skin-tight clothing (veiled nudity), and exaggerated physical animations (jiggle physics). There is no explicit nudity or sexual acts.
